hook: Don't just get an AI answer. Find the record behind it.
caption: An AI answer is only as good as what you can check behind it. Ask your records, get the answer, then open the entries it came from. That's context, not just a chat reply. Ask your records. #healthgraph #askyourrecords #selftracking #evidencebased #healthjournal #digitaldiary #transparency #healthtech #personalhealth #contextmatters

lines.text: Don't just get an AI answer. Find the record behind it.
lines.beat: ai-chat screen: suggested card How did I sleep this week is tapped, chat thread opens, Wellness info only disclaimer visible

lines.text: Ask your records a real question, like how you slept this week.
lines.beat: ai-chat: question types into the Ask about your health input, 2 AI messages per month FREE badge visible

lines.text: The answer comes back in plain language.
lines.beat: ai-chat: reply card slides in over the dark chat background

lines.text: But every answer points back to where it came from.
lines.beat: reply card dissolves into a row of evidence cards, green connector lines draw from the answer to each source

lines.text: The sleep log, the daily log, the entries behind the claim.
lines.beat: daily-log and patterns-sleep screens slide in as source cards: sleep 7h, Sleep duration 420min steady

lines.text: You can open the source and check it yourself.
lines.beat: paper report opens: daily-report cream card 3 OCT, Pulse 59 BPM entry highlighted, Log x6 footer

lines.text: That's the difference between an answer and evidence.
lines.beat: split view: answer card left, source cards right, connector lines hold, hierarchy clear

lines.text: Context, not just a chat reply.
lines.beat: health-graph: 2 OCT and 3 OCT nodes link up with the source entries, filter chips All Visit Heart Sleep Nutrition visible
end card: healthgraph wordmark, Ask your records
